name: Location Share on Checkout by Prismasell
author: Prismasell

sections.description: WooCommerce Location Share Plugin Demo URL : https://locationshare.prismasell.com/product-category/perfumes/ For Customization Request: https://prismasell.com/product/woocommerce-location-share-plugin-by-prismasell-one-click-location-sharing/ Description: The WooCommerce Location Share plugin streamlines the checkout process by allowing customers to share their precise location with a single click. This plugin integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce, adding a “Share Current Location” button at checkout that utilizes the browser’s geolocation API. When customers click the button, the plugin captures their exact latitude and longitude, which are then added to the order details along with a Google Maps link for easy location tracking. Key Features One-Click Location Sharing: Customers simply click a button to share their exact location, helping ensure accurate deliveries. Automatic Google Maps Link Generation: Converts latitude and longitude into a Google Maps link, making navigation easier for delivery teams. User-Friendly Integration: Adds a location field at checkout, with no need for manual entry, providing a smooth and easy experience for users. Compatibility: Works with WooCommerce and compatible custom checkout plugins, ensuring seamless integration. How It Works Enabling the Plugin: After installation, activate the plugin in WordPress. This will add a location-sharing button to the WooCommerce checkout page. Checkout Process: During checkout, customers will see a “Share Current Location” button next to the location field. By clicking it, they allow their browser to share their current location with the store. Order Details: The customer’s latitude and longitude coordinates are saved and included in the order details, accessible by the store admin. A Google Maps link is automatically generated for direct access to the customer’s location. Privacy & Security: The plugin uses the secure browser geolocation API, respecting customer privacy while capturing only necessary location data. Installation Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/woocommerce-location-share directory or install it directly through the WordPress plugins screen. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress. Once activated, the plugin will automatically add the location-sharing functionality to your WooCommerce checkout page. Frequently Asked Questions Q: Will this plugin work with custom WooCommerce checkout plugins? A: Yes, it is compatible with most custom WooCommerce checkout plugins. Q: Does the plugin store customer location data permanently? A: No, the plugin only attaches the location data to the specific order for delivery accuracy and does not store it elsewhere.
